3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: As Vina and I walked into the council chambers, we found the other councilors already there, deep in conversation.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: As I walked into the council chambers, I found the other councilors already there, deep in conversation.

8.speaker: Lucita Azaro
8.text: "A superpower suddenly taking an interest in this part of the continent -- what's next? All of our children will have to learn Arcasian?"

9.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
9.text: "The decision wasn't made with any ill intent towards Rizia. There are greater global forces at work than what's happening in our corner of South Merkopa."

10.speaker: Hugo Toras
10.text: "What the superpowers decide affects us, Mr. Esquibel. Their intent is of no importance."

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: All three fell silent. Laurento stared at me, somewhat taken aback.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: The three of them noticed me and fell silent.

17.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
17.text: "We were just discussing the recent news concerning Lespia's membership in ATO."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "I agree with Duchess Azaro. We should be very concerned."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "I agree with Mr. Esquibel. There's nothing to worry about."

20.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
20.text: "Why do you believe that, Your Majesty?"

21.speaker: Hugo Toras
21.text: "May I ask what makes you so certain?"

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "With Arcasia's backing, Lespia is bound to strengthen its grip on Pales."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Arcasia has a track record of sowing instability. We can't afford another uprising."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Lespia and Arcasia have been close for a decade. This just puts a name to it."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "Southern Merkopa cannot be allowed to fall under the influence of superpowers. We ought to be our *own* superpower."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "The superpowers won't touch us as long as we have Rumburg as an ally."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "Lespia won't get too bold. Not with Valgsland and the CSP around to keep them in check."

28.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
28.text: "A very ambitious goal, considering how divided we are."

29.speaker: Lucita Azaro
29.text: "Which will certainly threaten the tenuous peace we have established with both nations."

30.speaker: Lucita Azaro
30.text: "Rarely has ATO expanded without chaos following close behind."

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: The day of my foreign policy council meeting had arrived, and it was a hot one.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: I spent a while wandering around, then returned to the middle of the garden, where a series of stone sculptures were surrounded by Rizian palms and succulents.

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "We don't know anything about the situation yet. We'll have to wait and see what happens."

35.speaker: Lucita Azaro
35.text: "Names have weight, Your Majesty. So do atomic weapons."

36.speaker: Lucita Azaro
36.text: "Even worse, Your Majesty. That means Rizia is caught in the middle."

37.speaker: Lucita Azaro
37.text: "Queen Beatrice is already making overtures towards Arcasia. With Queen Lena dead, which side do you think she'll take?"

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: Laurento walked to the chamber's back wall and pulled down a map of southeastern Merkopa.

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Wehlen"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) == false)

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Isn't Pales the topic of the day?"
41.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Pales"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) == false)

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "I haven't heard much about the countries of the former Empire of Moridia."
42.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) == false)

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Sordland"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) == false)

44.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
44.text: "Now that the Colonel has decided to retire, you mean?"

45.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
45.text: "His successor is called Ewald Alphonso. From everything I've heard, he's Soll's exact opposite."

50.speaker: Lucita Azaro
50.text: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, this council exists so that you may base your actions on more than mere gut feelings."

51.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
51.text: "What would you have us do, Duchess Azaro? We're on shaky enough ground with Lespia as it is."

52.speaker: Lucita Azaro
52.text: "Of course we should act sensibly. But we need to show the Republic and its new friends that Rizia can hold its own."

53.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
53.text: "It depends. He's already instituted some major changes..."

54.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
54.text: "Think sweeping privatization and tax cuts. Sollists forced out of power. More women in prominent positions-- although he has yet to pass the kind of liberatory reforms our beloved Lyza did."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "That's too bad. I actually liked Soll."

56.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
56.text: "The feeling wasn't mutual. Soll's disdain for the monarchy kept us shut out of trade negotiations with Sordland for decades."

57.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
57.text: "Do you want to discuss Morella? Or Derdia?"

60.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
60.text: "Ah, yes. The only fully Golcondist nation in the world."

61.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
61.text: "You've already heard about their new left-wing ruling coalition, correct?"

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: Laurento rearranged some of the papers he was holding.

64.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
64.text: "Relations with our onetime allies have been turbulent at best since the civil war. The international unpopularity of current president Wiktor Smolak has only complicated matters."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "My father made a deal with Wehlen on good faith. Wehlen so far has respected the deal."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "All I ask is that Wehlen return Zille as promised. After that, I'm happy to cut ties."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Rizia wouldn't be where we are today without Wehlen. We can't abandon our partnership."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "It's not a good look for us to remain linked to them."

69.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
69.text: "It's not wrong. One might see it that way."

70.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
70.text: "The return is scheduled for the end of 1952, Your Majesty."

71.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
71.text: "Rumburg in particular has been vocal about ending the Smolak regime. But as long as Wehlen still holds Zille, diplomacy is key."

72.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
72.text: "Smolak has made nothing but enemies in the international arena, Rumburg chief among them. But yes, as long as Wehlen still holds Zille, diplomacy is paramount."

73.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
73.text: "I was just about to bring up the Grand Duchy."

77.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
77.text: "Friendship Day is the 'celebration' that's been held in Zille each year since the treaty was signed."

78.speaker: Lucita Azaro
78.text: "Since Smolak took over, he's used the occasion to trot out all the shiny new tanks Wehlen's oil money and United Contanan funding has bought him."

79.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
79.text: "Your presence will at the very least remind him of the occupation's temporary nature."

80.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
80.text: "I know you and Duke Reinhart had a rather ill-fated meeting some years ago. But it's not too late to mend those bridges."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "I'm looking forward to it. Our nations have been estranged for too long."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I doubt it. He knows I showed Father his letter."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "As long as he doesn't expect too much from me."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "It was Father's fault. He forced me to betray the Duke's confidence."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Reinhart reached out to me because he was desperate. Sooner or later, he'll come crawling back to us."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "I still don't know why Axel even bothered. He knows full well what Rizians think of his so-called 'country'."

87.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
87.text: "I myself advised your father to speak with the new Duke of Pales. To no avail, of course."

88.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
88.text: "Your father's unfortunate passing has given us a chance for a fresh start with Duke Reinhart."

89.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
89.text: "I heard he reached out to you some years ago. Perhaps that connection can be built upon."

90.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
90.text: "All he expects is a warmer reception than the one Valero gave him. Which I would recommend anyway."

91.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
91.text: "Perhaps now is our chance for a fresh start."

94.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
94.text: "After years of infighting, the country's left-leaning parties miraculously united in time to win this year's elections."

95.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
95.text: "The politician who managed this feat is now Morella's new prime minister. Alma Saltana, or as she might prefer it, *Comrade* Alma Saltana."

97.speaker: Hugo Toras
97.text: "Lespia and ATO are enough of a threat without the Malenyevists knocking at our back door."

98.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
98.text: "Morella doesn't stand a chance of entering the Contanan Security Pact. Not with its current levels of poverty."

99.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
99.text: "But there are rumors that Prime Minister Saltana has been arranging meetings with Valgslandian Chancellor Emmerich Hegel."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Didn't Rizia and Valgsland used to be allies?"

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "I'll make him remember. By any means necessary."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "I'm looking forward to it. I see no reason why Rizia and Wehlen can't be close again."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "I'll talk to him. Maybe we can come to a productive agreement."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I still don't know if he can be trusted."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "And how are our relations with Valgsland at the moment?"

106.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
106.text: "I must say that their Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal did not approve of our ban on Golcondist pilgrims to Rizian holy sites."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "You think Hegel is trying to get Morella into the CSP?"

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "Can Morella be swayed away from Valgish influence?"

111.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
111.text: "It's possible. But we'd have to have something to offer."

112.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
112.text: "Not currently. But Valgsland throwing its support behind Morella's leftward turn is concerning enough."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "You're right. Malenyev and his followers are the real menace."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "Arcasian liberalism is a far worse threat to our way of life than Malenyevism."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "As long as we remain on good terms with Morella, I don't care about the country's political leanings."

118.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
118.text: "An admirable impulse. But this is unfortunately only a ceremony, not a diplomatic talk."

119.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
119.text: "Circumstances have changed since the '20s, of course. But it's good that you are still holding out that hope."

120.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
120.text: "There is one more country we haven't discussed. Rumburg."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Is there even anything to discuss? They're our allies."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "I always expected Beatrice to turn on me after Lena died. I'm amazed she's stayed allied with us."

124.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
124.text: "For the moment, Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

125.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
125.text: "Yes, for the time being, Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: Laurento turned away from the map towards me.

155.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
155.text: "Of course. Queen Beatrice and her country are firmly allied with Rizia."

156.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
156.text: "Our allies, Queen Beatrice and her country, are doing fine from what we're seeing."

158.speaker: Lucita Azaro
158.text: "Considering the state of Zille since it landed in Wehlen's hands, I see no point in remaining diplomatic. Have you been there lately? It's an industrial wasteland."

159.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
159.text: "Wehlen's access to Zille's land and resources helped bring it out of recession after the war. Smolak will have difficulty letting go of such a valuable asset."

160.speaker: Hugo Toras
160.text: "Some argue Wehlen did little but accelerate the development that was already occurring in the region prior to the handover."

161.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
161.text: "Either way, Wehlen's access to Zille's land and resources helped bring it out of recession after the war. Smolak will have difficulty letting go of such a valuable asset."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "Can we count on him to honor the terms of the treaty?"

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "Can the international community be relied on to intervene if Smolak breaks a signed pact?"

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "What about the people of Zille? Surely they can't wait for the land to be returned to Rizia."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "I will act diplomatically with President Smolak. We can sweeten the deal if, necessary. I will appease him until we get Zille back."

166.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
166.text: "Half of the country's native Rizian population fled during the civil war. Like the Queen Mother's parents, I recall."

167.speaker: Elena Werner
167.text: "Given how many countries depend on Wehzek oil, either directly or indirectly, I wouldn't be so sure about that."

168.speaker: Hugo Toras
168.text: "Smolak's current focus is on eradicating terrorism by the Bluds, a Golcondist ethnic group native to Wehlen and Sordland. He's been very vocal about his desire for cooperation on that front."

169.speaker: Lucita Azaro
169.text: "Smolak is not as weak as he seems. It will take a great deal of time and effort before our firepower matches his. He may act bold."

170.speaker: Lucita Azaro
170.text: "Among those who were stubborn enough to stay, opinion is divided. We have to remember that it's been almost 25 years."

171.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
171.text: "In the meantime, any perceived aggression on our part may only give him an excuse to break it."

172.speaker: Lucita Azaro
172.text: "The funding Wehlen has received from United Contana may also have Smolak believing he can act with impunity."

173.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
173.text: "Not all Bluds are terrorists, Your Grace. Mr. Smolak is particularly interested in the separatist group known as the Bludish Freedom Front. Who have been rumored to be receiving support from none other than Rumburg."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "That name's got to be some kind of joke."

176.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
176.text: "President Smolak fancies himself the humorous type, Your Majesty."

177.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
177.text: "Speaking of Lyza, she's the one who first opened trade negotiations with Sordland back when it was still a kingdom. But Soll's disdain for the monarchy kept us from continuing down that path."

178.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
178.text: "The Alphonso administration, meanwhile, has no such qualms about royalty. In fact, his new development minister Gus Manger has already had personal business dealings in Rizia."

179.speaker: Hugo Toras
179.text: "Our friend Mr. Montoro of Rizian Royal Gold has been making overtures to the Sordish oligarchy, it seems. Birds of crassly ostentatious plumage flock together."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I don't like your tone, Hugo. Rusty and the Sordish oligarchs are self-made men. I respect that."

182.speaker: Elena Werner
182.text: "That hasn't been disclosed yet. The country already has abundant gas resources. They could be looking to shore up their Central Bank with gold in the wake of Alphonso's privatization spree."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "I'm not sure if I trust either Alphonso or his minister. But I'm open to proposals."

185.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
185.text: "It would be a feat to repair our ties with Sordland. Perhaps the glory days of Lyza are not lost after all."

186.speaker: Hugo Toras
186.text: "A commoner with money is like a monkey with a wristwatch. Entertaining for a while, but what's he really going to do with it?"

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Wealthy commoners making plans behind our back. It doesn't smell good."

188.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
188.text: "Ms. Werner already mentioned the large amounts of gold we export to the country through their strategic Port Grim."

189.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
189.text: "We also have a deal allowing Rumburg's ships priority access to our ports in Porte Drazon and Monqiz. We are, in essence, their gateway to the Antacean Sea."

190.speaker: Lucita Azaro
190.text: "Militarily speaking, the alliance doesn't amount to much. Rumburg will supply us with arms in case of war, but neither of our countries is officially obligated to come to the other's aid."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "What are these rumors about Rumburg interfering in Wehlen?"

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "Is the Queen plotting anything against Sordland?"

193.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
193.text: "It won't be behind your back for long, Your Majesty. Both Alphonso and Manger want to talk to you."

194.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
194.text: "Not a bad analogy, Your Grace. But these are the men who hold the power in Sordland. We'll have to deal with them sooner or later."

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "Duchess Azaro mentioned Rumburg was getting closer to Arcasia."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "I've heard that Rumburg has been getting closer to Arcasia?"

200.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
200.text: "Yes, the Queen is in trade talks with Arcasia as well as western neighbors Nahrbuk and Erdmarg."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "Does Rumburg want anything else from us?"

202.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
202.text: "The countries haven't been in overt conflict since the 15-Day War."

203.speaker: Lucita Azaro
203.text: "But to answer your question, Your Majesty, I wouldn't be surprised. We're already fairly sure Rumburg is arming Bludish separatists in Wehlen. The same might well be happening across the border in Bergia."

204.speaker: Lucita Azaro
204.text: "Nothing's been proven, Your Majesty. But we're fairly sure Rumburg has been arming Bludish separatists in the country's northeast. The same might be happening across the border in Sordland."

205.speaker: Lucita Azaro
205.text: "The country's energy needs are insatiable. It's been reaching out to any country with oil or natural gas resources."

206.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
206.text: "Maybe not from us, but the country's energy needs are insatiable."

207.speaker: Lucita Azaro
207.text: "The Queen's interested in any country with oil or natural gas resources."

208.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
208.text: "In other words, if we do start drilling in that new field off Ales, I expect Her Excellency will soon come calling."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "That's smart. Queen Beatrice will get further with these kinds of destabilization efforts than with outright hostility."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "So our alliance with Rumburg is a liability when it comes to relations with Wehlen and Sordland."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "Who's to say she won't try the same shenanigans with us?"

212.speaker: Lucita Azaro
212.text: "I wouldn't rule out the possibility of escalation. Both countries are rich in the one thing Rumburg still needs: energy."

213.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
213.text: "She'd have nothing to gain from it, Your Majesty. We're already giving Rumburg nearly everything it wants."

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "Except natural gas. If we do end up with a stake in the new gas field, I expect Her Excellency will soon come calling."

215.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
215.text: "Our alliance shouldn't stop us from pursuing diplomacy with either nation."

216.speaker: Lucita Azaro
216.text: "But I wouldn't rule out the possibility of escalation from Rumburg's side. Both countries are rich in the one thing Rumburg still needs: energy."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "That's presumptuous of her. There are plenty of other potential uses for that gas."

218.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
218.text: "Yes, Her Excellency has made Rumburg's oil and natural gas needs plainly known. If we end up with a stake in that new field, I fully expect her to come calling."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "Becoming one of Rumburg's main energy suppliers would definitely strengthen our partnership."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "You're getting ahead of yourself. Ownership of that field hasn't even been decided yet."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "What is Rumburg even using all of this energy for?"

222.speaker: Lucita Azaro
222.text: "They've been manufacturing a lot more than KA-74s lately. I've heard stories about experimental weapons that would put Arcasia's to shame."

223.speaker: Lucita Azaro
223.text: "But you see now how important it is for that decision to be made in Rizia's favor."

224.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
224.text: "It would. Whether that's good or bad in the eyes of the international community is another question."

225.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
225.text: "True. Both Morella and Derdia are struggling to meet their own energy needs."

226.speaker: Hugo Toras
226.text: "Fortunately, we have living evidence of that bond right here at this table."

230.speaker: Narrator
230.text: All eyes turned to Vina. She looked up from the notes she'd been taking.

231.speaker: Vina Toras
231.text: "Um, yes. Don't worry, Aunt Bea still dotes on me. I'm like the daughter she never had."

232.speaker: Hugo Toras
232.text: "Fortunately, we have living evidence of that bond within these palace walls."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "Beatrice still dotes on Vina. She's like the daughter she never had."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Yes, Beatrice is still fond of me. She knows how much I loved Lena."

236.speaker: Hugo Toras
236.text: "Good. I hope it's clear to the young lady how important it is for her to stay in Her Excellency's good graces."

237.speaker: Hugo Toras
237.text: "I was referring to Vina. But I'm glad you've stayed in Her Excellency's good graces."

238.speaker: Hugo Toras
238.text: "Good. See to it that you remain in Her Excellency's good graces."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "Vina is a human being, She's not a diplomatic tool."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "She's a human being, Uncle Hugo. Not a diplomatic tool."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "The Queen is still fond of me as well. She knows how much I loved my Lena."

242.speaker: Vina Toras
242.text: "Maybe it's time we both arranged a visit with Aunt Bea."

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: Vina pressed her pencil down on her notepad so hard that it broke with an audible snap.

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "You heard him, Vina. Maybe it's time we arranged a visit with dear Aunt Bea."

248.speaker: Vina Toras
248.text: "It's okay. I understand Uncle Hugo's point. I'll be sure to keep up correspondence with Aunt Bea."

249.speaker: Hugo Toras
249.text: "The young lady is a princess. There are certain expectations that come with the role."

250.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
250.text: "Thanks for listening, everyone. I do hope I haven't been too much of a bore."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Not at all, Mr. Esquibel. I've always enjoyed sharing in your expertise."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Not at all, Mr. Esquibel. It's a privilege to share in your expertise."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "Now that you mention it, try to make the next meeting a little more concise."

259.speaker: Narrator
259.text: He rolled the map back up and collected his belongings.

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: The fans in Palas Rezna provided little relief. I decided to take in some fresh air in the palace gardens.

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: Pabel had hired a new groundskeeper who faithfully maintained his father's arrangements.

265.speaker: Narrator
265.text: I didn't know much about the many plants and flowers on display around me. But they were pleasing to look at and provided some welcome shade.

266.speaker: Narrator
266.text: Before he was my butler, my friend had explained to me that the plants and flowers here were laid out geographically: Rikan ferns in the east, Xinan lilies to the south, a Rumburg-style rose garden in the north.

267.speaker: Elena Werner
267.text: "Sooner, in this case, Your Majesty. I'll contact you once Alphonso has agreed on a date for his visit."

268.speaker: Elena Werner
268.text: "I'll contact you once Alphonso has agreed on a date for his visit."

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: I walked out of the chambers, glad to be done for the day.

271.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
271.text: "As we all know, House Toras has historical ties to the late Valgos Empire. But Chancellor Hegel isn't exactly brimming with nostalgia for that era."

272.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
272.text: "House Toras was close with the Valgos Empire, yes. But it's been 30 years since the revolution. And Chancellor Hegel isn't exactly nostalgic for the old days."

274.speaker: Hugo Toras
274.text: "Lespia and ATO are enough of a threat without the Malenyevists knocking at our back door."

275.speaker: Hugo Toras
275.text: "This new prime minister 'Comrade' Alma Saltana worries me."

276.speaker: Lucita Azaro
276.text: "Respectfully, Your Grace, there's nothing 'reasonable' about allowing Arcasia and its puppets to spread instability across the globe."

277.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
277.text: "Compared to his brother Njolma, Axel Reinhart seems far more amenable to a thaw between our countries."

278.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
278.text: "He wasn't even born when Rizia and Pales were fighting. And I suspect he is beginning to see the disadvantages of staying connected to Lespia."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "Tell me more about the current relationship between Pales and Lespia."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "Pales still has a Rizian-speaking population, right? How influential are they?"

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "Where's Valgsland in all this? Does Pales have any relationship with the republic?"

282.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
282.text: "The Grand Duchy has been heavily dependent on the Republic of Lespia since the 1920s, Your Majesty."

283.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
283.text: "Our northern neighbor has taken extensive advantage of the natural gas reserves off the southern Palesian coast."

284.speaker: Lucita Azaro
284.text: "In addition to the resulting income, Pales has access to Lespian technology and military equipment, which at the moment surpasses our own."

285.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
285.text: "They are a minority, but a vocal one."

286.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
286.text: "They believe in the preservation of the Rizian language, but they still consider themselves Palesian at heart."

287.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
287.text: "Lespia has also relocated a number of its major corporations to Pales in exchange for *extremely* generous tax breaks."

288.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
288.text: "Duke Njolma's proposed Rizian ban was a bridge too far for them. They seem to heavily favor his brother."

290.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
290.text: "Most Valgish Palesians were and still are vehemently against their ancestral homeland's turn to socialism."

291.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
291.text: "In turn, the Republic of Valgsland has had nothing to do with its former colony since the Reinharts' decision to seek protection from Lespia."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "I'm beginning to get a good grasp of the situation there."

295.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
295.text: "Are you leaning towards any particular diplomatic strategy regarding Pales, Your Majesty?"

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "We should play on the sympathies of the Rizian-speaking segment of the population. Sway them over to our side."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "A Valgslandian Socialist revolution, you say? Is it too late to start one over there now?"

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "My previous opinion stands. I don't think we should have anything to do with them."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "I bear no ill will towards Pales. You're right that a closer relationship would be advantageous."

303.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
303.text: "That would be... highly inadvisable. Aside from the violence that would result, it would leave Rizia open to a similar fate."

304.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
304.text: "That could prove useful, Your Majesty. Especially in the face of Lespia's ATO membership."

306.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
306.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. Although the gas field dear Elena mentioned during her briefing may eventually force us into dealings with the Grand Duke."

308.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
308.text: "It will, Your Majesty. Especially if we need to negotiate ownership of the gas field dear Elena mentioned during her briefing."

309.speaker: Lucita Azaro
309.text: "For once we agree, Mr. Esquibel. Let's leave Valgsland far out of this."

316.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
316.text: "I would remind you of the necessity to remain civil. We cannot give Mr. Smolak a reason to break the contract."

328.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
328.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_PalesInfo_Rizian"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_PalesInfo_Lespia"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_PalesInfo_Valgsland"] == true) == false

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Ms. Werner, will this new alliance have economic consequences?"

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Laurento, what are our current relations with Lespia?"

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "Hugo, does this development pose a threat to the Rizian monarchy?"

337.speaker: Elena Werner
337.text: "Our most significant economic relationship with Lespia is our partnership in the Meftiem International Trade Zone."

338.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
338.text: "I would categorize them as neutral but frosty, Your Majesty."

339.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
339.text: "Queen Lyza's diplomacy kept us on good terms with Lespia for a time after their transition to democracy. But things were beginning to sour even before the Pales conflict."

340.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
340.text: "We still maintain embassies in each other's countries. But I haven't met with their foreign ministry since before the election of their new prime minister, Alvarez."

341.speaker: Elena Werner
341.text: "Having Arcasia behind them might well embolden Lespia to push for a larger share in the MITZ. But they'd also have Valgsland and Morella to contend with."

342.speaker: Hugo Toras
342.text: "Not an immediate one, Your Majesty. But we must be watchful."

343.speaker: Hugo Toras
343.text: "We have seen Arcasian-backed revolutions succeed in Rika and Xina. And we do suspect the Sazons were communicating with Arcasia prior to the 1926 uprising."

344.speaker: Hugo Toras
344.text: "Qinal's ATO membership was already cause for concern five years ago. With Lespia in the alliance as well, Arcasia's influence is present to both our north and our south. There is great potential for destabilization."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "What are the security implications of this alliance, Duchess Azaro?"

346.speaker: Lucita Azaro
346.text: "We can definitely expect the Arcasian military to increase their presence in Lespia."

347.speaker: Lucita Azaro
347.text: "Lespia already houses Arcasian military personnel. Air and naval bases cannot be far behind."

348.speaker: Lucita Azaro
348.text: "I can't say for certain that all that firepower will be directed against us in case of a conflict. But it does enhance the threat that Lespia -- and, yes, potentially Pales -- poses to our kingdom."

363.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
363.text: "On the other hand, Your Grace, Arcasia has friendly ties with at least one monarchy. You may recall that President Dwight Walker actually boasts Rumburgian heritage."

364.speaker: Elena Werner
364.text: "Lespia using Arcasia's backing to strengthen its economic ties with Pales could also have negative ramifications, especially when it comes to the new gas field."

366.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
366.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Lucita"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Hugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Laurento"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Elena"] == true

367.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
367.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Lucita"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Hugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Laurento"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Elena"] == true) == false

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "All right. What do you all think I should do?"
368.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Lucita"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Hugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Laurento"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Elena"] == true

369.speaker: Narrator
369.text: Everybody began talking at once. Hugo motioned for silence.

370.speaker: Hugo Toras
370.text: "In my view, Rizia should bolster our alliances with our fellow monarchies, like Rumburg and the rest of the Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange."

371.speaker: Hugo Toras
371.text: "Building stronger bonds with them will not only enrich us, it will counterbalance ATO's democratic influence."

372.speaker: Lucita Azaro
372.text: "This is true. But we can't rely on GRACE to come to our aid in a conflict. For that, we will need to build up our military and defense capabilities."

373.speaker: Elena Werner
373.text: "I'd say it's more crucial to form new trade relationships with our other neighbors. If Lespia becomes even more of an economic juggernaut in our region, it'll upset the balance of power."

378.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
378.text: "And I don't think we should ignore the opportunity to thaw our relationship with Lespia itself. I for one would rather handle them as a friend than a foe."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_LespiaATO_Vina"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false)

389.speaker: Sal Ignacius
389.text: "Well, Your Majesty, the teachings of St. Wruhec compel us to exercise goodwill and compassion towards our neighbors."

390.speaker: Sal Ignacius
390.text: "On the other hand, we must be watchful that Lespia does not use its new international clout to further the spread of the Dastnurist faith."

391.speaker: Vina Toras
391.text: "We certainly don't want tensions to rise with Lespia at this point, do we? But we don't want ATO's influence to overwhelm us, either..."

392.speaker: Vina Toras
392.text: "What about using cultural exchanges and other partnerships to spread Rizia's own influence beyond our borders?"

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "I'd like to get a full picture of Rizia's geopolitical situation before offering my own opinion."

396.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
396.text: "Certainly, Your Majesty. That's what today is for."

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "How do you think it would be helpful in Zille?"

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "Why would there be a need for it in Pales?"

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "I can see the use for such a program. But do we have the budget for it?"

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "My mind is made up. I'd rather not fund the ATA in either Zille or Pales."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "What does my great-great-grandmother have to do with anything?"

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "No, I already know I'm not interested."

407.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
407.text: "It's currently active in Rumburg and a few other GRACE members. Its satellites organize Rizian language classes, concerts, art exhibitions, traditional festivals..."

408.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
408.text: "Your esteemed ancestor first had the idea of funding an organization devoted to promoting Rizian culture abroad."

409.speaker: Lucita Azaro
409.text: "And if not... we'll need as many Rizian sympathizers on the inside as we can get."

412.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
412.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Sordland"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Pales"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == true) == false

429.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
429.text: "I would advise against getting involved with the BFF. But Wehlen's isolation within Merkopa could be a strategic advantage on our end. For all his posturing, I believe Wiktor Smolak truly wants Rizia as an ally."

432.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
432.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Bargain"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Internal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Pressure"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Intimidate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_War"] == true

433.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
433.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Bargain"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Internal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Pressure"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Intimidate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_War"] == true) == false

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "Moving on... when is my next diplomatic visit to Wehlen?"
434.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Bargain"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Internal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Pressure"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Intimidate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_Diplomacy_Wehlen_War"] == true

435.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
435.text: "As a matter of fact, you're slated for a trip to Zille at the end of this year, for the second-to-last Wehzek-Rizian Friendship Day."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "I was open to closer ties with Pales before. But Lespia's ATO membership might make that more complicated."

440.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
440.text: "Your instincts are correct, Your Majesty. There's also the matter of the gas field dear Elena mentioned during her own briefing."

441.speaker: Elena Werner
441.text: "Yes, explorations are still ongoing, but there's a good indication that both Rizia and Pales could have a claim to the new resource."

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "I'd rather not have anything to do with them. But in the face of Lespia's ATO membership, we should attempt diplomacy."

444.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
444.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. Although the gas field dear Elena mentioned during her briefing may eventually force us into dealings with the Grand Duke."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "Both Arcasian liberals and Malenyevists hate everything we stand for."

448.speaker: Elena Werner
448.text: "Their leanings do affect our relationship, Your Majesty."

449.speaker: Hugo Toras
449.text: "Neither ideology respects the sovereignty of a monarch. I see them as two sides of one coin."

453.speaker: Sal Ignacius
453.text: "Yes, His Majesty and I discussed that ban prior to our ceremony in Plavo."

457.speaker: Sal Ignacius
457.text: "Yes, His Majesty and I discussed that ban in Plavo, prior to what would have been our ceremony."

459.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
459.text: "In this case, it's Valgslandian Socialism we ought to be worried about, not Malenyevism."

460.speaker: Elena Werner
460.text: "So far, our trade relationships with Morella have not been affected. Nor has our partnership in the International Trade Zone."

461.speaker: Elena Werner
461.text: "But Morella and Valgsland teaming up in that arena could potentially be more of a concern than Lespia."

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "Indeed, Grand Wiseman. The Golcondists' blasphemous version of St. Wruhec's teachings does not belong in Rizia."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "We did, and it struck me as unfair. The Golcondists are as Wruhecist as you or I. They deserve the right to worship."

464.speaker: Player_Romus
464.text: "I harbor reservations about it myself. But I trust the Grand Wiseman's decision."

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "If the ban is harming our relations with Derdia, perhaps it should be reconsidered."

466.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
466.text: "Our relations with them have become strained since the country's conversion to a theocracy. However, we still maintain a number of cooperative agreements, including our acceptance of Derdian migrants as labor hands."

467.speaker: Hugo Toras
467.text: "It belongs here more than Dastnurity. Though you may believe differently, Your Majesty."

471.speaker: Hugo Toras
471.text: "I think we can agree that it belongs here more than Dastnurity."

475.speaker: Hugo Toras
475.text: "Your openness to different beliefs is admirable, Your Majesty. But it may lead to conflict."

476.speaker: Hugo Toras
476.text: "Your openness to different beliefs -- even Dastnurity -- is admirable, Your Majesty. But it may lead to conflict."

477.speaker: Sal Ignacius
477.text: "They may have strayed, gentlemen, but Golcondists and Dastnurists are both our brethren."

478.speaker: Sal Ignacius
478.text: "I merely worried the growing numbers of Golcondist visitors at sites like Plavo -- and their rather physical interpretation of our religion -- were alienating the true Wruhecist believers."

479.speaker: Hugo Toras
479.text: "I would not be opposed to replacing the Golcondist ban with one on, say, Dastnurists."

480.speaker: Hugo Toras
480.text: "As do I. I wonder, though, why he has not put similar restrictions on Dastnurists."

481.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
481.text: "I will point out that our stance on Derdian Golcondists is far gentler than Morella's."

482.speaker: Elena Werner
482.text: "Yes, Morella hasn't allowed Derdians of any kind into the country since the Meftiem Invasion of 1915. Though the Derdians most certainly have tried."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "I sympathize with Morella. Those Golcondist lunatics should stay in their own country."

484.speaker: Player_Romus
484.text: "Then how are Derdian migrants reaching Rizia?"

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "Poor Derdians. They can't catch a break."

486.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
486.text: "Mostly by boat across the Gulf of Moridia. Though some are trafficked across the border, and others fight their way in."

487.speaker: Sal Ignacius
487.text: "Pilgrimages play a significant role in Golcondism, unfortunately. Whether to holy sites in Rizia and Morella, or to the Sordish Archsanctuary of Deyr."

488.speaker: Lucita Azaro
488.text: "Don't feel too sorry for them. They win their share of border skirmishes."

489.speaker: Lucita Azaro
489.text: "Say what you will about Derdians' beliefs. You can't argue with their weaponry."

490.speaker: Sal Ignacius
490.text: "It's part of their warrior culture, Duchess. Their practice is centered on martial discipline and physical strength."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "It'd be good to have a culture like that on our side."

494.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
494.text: "Everyone can be bargained with, Your Majesty. Like Wiktor Smolak, Mr. Azmal may be looking for a way to end his country's geopolitical isolation."

495.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
495.text: "They're not as dangerous as they may seem. Like Wehlen, Derdia is geopolitically isolated. They have few allies aside from the Bludish population in Wehlen."

496.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
496.text: "It will be hard to bargain with Derdia without compromising our ban. But it may be possible."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Derdia"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Sordland"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Pales"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_ForeignPolicy_Morella"] == true)

498.speaker: Hugo Toras
498.text: "I will remind the council of our prior conversation regarding ATO, and the necessity of strengthening our bond with other monarchies. Especially Rumburg."

499.speaker: Narrator
499.text: My councilors looked at me in expectation.

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "I think Hugo has the right idea. Aligning more closely with Rumburg and GRACE will protect us from Arcasia's growing sphere of influence."

501.speaker: Player_Romus
501.text: "I like Elena's suggestion. Sealing new economic pacts with other Merkopan countries will help us become a regional power in our own right."

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "I agree with Lucita that we cannot look weak in Lespia and Arcasia's eyes. Our military and intelligence should be our number one focus."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "Laurento, you're right that it would behoove us to grow closer to Lespia and ATO instead of making enemies of them."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "You all have very good ideas. I will consider a combination of these approaches."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "Brilliant, Vina. Arcasia isn't the only nation capable of promoting itself through soft power."

506.speaker: Player_Romus
506.text: "I'm not sure. If we use the wrong approach, other countries might see it as a provocation."

507.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
507.text: "I have an idea regarding this. I'll bring it up at the end of the meeting."

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "I like that idea in theory. But it sounds expensive."

512.speaker: Sal Ignacius
512.text: "You were right to grant Wehzek Dastnurists a place to practice in this country. But we must also safeguard our own beliefs."

514.speaker: Lucita Azaro
514.text: "Yes, it should. The others' suggestions are useless if we are unable to come to our own defense."

515.speaker: Elena Werner
515.text: "Correct, Your Majesty. I've identified one with particular potential that I will bring up shortly."

517.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
517.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. We do not have to subscribe to Arcasian ideology to benefit from their proximity."

524.speaker: Hugo Toras
524.text: "Mr. Esquibel, you had prepared an overview of our current geopolitical situation prior to this development. Would you care to proceed with that?"

526.speaker: Hugo Toras
526.text: "I must admit I'm uneasy with this idea. But I trust our foreign councilor's many years of experience."

527.speaker: Hugo Toras
527.text: "Strengthening our military and our relationship with Rumburg are, fortunately, not mutually exclusive."

528.speaker: Hugo Toras
528.text: "I am intrigued, Ms. Werner. Though I still believe our most important economic relationship is with Rumburg."

529.speaker: Narrator
529.text: My councilors looked at me in expectation.

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "Hugo has the right idea. Aligning more closely with Rumburg and GRACE will protect us from Arcasia's growing sphere of influence."

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: "I like Elena's suggestion. Sealing new economic pacts with other Merkopan countries will help us become a regional power in our own right."

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "I agree with Lucita that we cannot look weak in Lespia and Valgsland's eyes. Our military and intelligence should be our number one focus."

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: "Laurento, you're right that it would behoove us to grow closer to Lespia and ATO instead of making enemies of them."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "You all have very good ideas. I will consider a combination of these approaches."

535.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
535.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. We do not have to subscribe to Arcasian ideology to benefit from their proximity."

542.speaker: Hugo Toras
542.text: "I must admit I'm uneasy with this idea. But I trust our foreign councilor's many years of experience."

543.speaker: Hugo Toras
543.text: "Strengthening our military and our relationship with Rumburg are, fortunately, not mutually exclusive."

544.speaker: Hugo Toras
544.text: "I am intrigued, Ms. Werner. Though I still believe our most important economic relationship is with Rumburg."

545.speaker: Lucita Azaro
545.text: "Yes, it should. The others' suggestions are useless if we are unable to come to our own defense."

546.speaker: Elena Werner
546.text: "Correct, Your Majesty. I think the Sordland deal has particularly high potential."

551.speaker: Hugo Toras
551.text: "Was that all from you, Mr. Esquibel?"

552.speaker: Hugo Toras
552.text: "Before we conclude, there is still the matter of His Majesty's stance on Lespia's ATO membership. Do you have any further thoughts on that?"

557.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
557.text: "I did have one more proposition before we adjourn."

558.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
558.text: "I was quite fond of the Princess' suggestion that we increase Rizian soft power outside of our borders."

559.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
559.text: "One fairly risk-free way to increase our geopolitical footprint without losing any country's favor is to expand Rizia's soft power."

560.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
560.text: "We have also spoken of the need to stoke pro-Rizian sympathies in both Zille and Pales."

561.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
561.text: "I would therefore suggest funding branches of the Ariana Toras Association in both of those regions."

562.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
562.text: "It's a government-funded organization that promotes Rizian culture abroad."

563.speaker: Player_Romus
563.text: "I'm familiar with the Ariana Toras Association. Do you really think it would be useful in those regions?"

571.speaker: Hugo Toras
571.text: "If I may, Your Majesty. There are children Vina's age in Zille who have spent their whole lives believing they're Wehzek."

572.speaker: Hugo Toras
572.text: "I myself volunteered with the ATA as an ambassador for a time. I can vouch for its integrity."

578.speaker: Hugo Toras
578.text: "If the handover goes as planned, we will need to remind Zille citizens of their true heritage."

579.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
579.text: "If you truly intend to reconcile with Pales, strengthening the pro-Rizian sympathies of the population is a good start."

586.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
586.text: "If our goal is to become closer with our neighbors, this might help steer Pales away from Lespia and towards us."

590.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
590.text: "If our goal is to become closer with Lespia and ATO, winning over Palesians could be a good start."
590.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_FriendlyToPales"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Diplomacy_Intention_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Diplomacy_Intention_ATO"] == true)

591.speaker: Lucita Azaro
591.text: "Language classes and concerts constitute a rather weak effort if you ask me. But they're a start."

592.speaker: Hugo Toras
592.text: "Now that Lespia is in ATO, I can envision them trying to introduce Arcasian values to Pales. A greater Rizian presence will help counter that."
592.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_FriendlyToPales"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Diplomacy_Intention_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Diplomacy_Intention_ATO"] == true) == false)

593.speaker: Hugo Toras
593.text: "Conversely, it could help keep Palesians firmly on the side of monarchy should Lespia try to introduce democracy there."

594.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
594.text: "We know Duke Reinhart tolerates and even encourages the Rizian language in Pales. He will not see this as a threat."

596.speaker: Elena Werner
596.text: "We do. But expanding ATA into both Zille and Pales will be costly indeed."

597.speaker: Elena Werner
597.text: "I like the idea -- it could even give us an edge in upcoming trade deals. But I would advise you to choose between the two regions."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "I see. Then let's fund a branch of the Ariana Toras Association in Zille." [-2 Budget]

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "I agree with you. We shall begin ATA activities in Pales only." [-2 Budget]

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "There is no need for frugality. Let's expand the ATA into both Zille and Pales." [-2 Authority, -4 Budget]

607.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
607.text: "I understand, Your Majesty. It was only a suggestion."

608.speaker: Narrator
608.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath from Elena.

609.speaker: Elena Werner
609.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. I'll allocate the funds."

611.speaker: Player_Romus
611.text: "It was Vina's suggestion, and it was a good one. But I have the budget earmarked for other uses."

615.speaker: Player_Romus
615.text: "Next time, don't steal silly ideas from young girls."

616.speaker: Player_Romus
616.text: "It was a good suggestion. But I have the budget earmarked for other uses."

617.speaker: Player_Romus
617.text: "I'm afraid of upsetting our already-delicate situation in both of those areas."

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "Your input is appreciated, Mr. Esquibel. But I am the king, and my decision is final."

620.speaker: Vina Toras
620.text: "That's perfectly all right, Your Majesty. Thanks for listening to me."

621.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
621.text: "I didn't find it silly at all, Your Highness. But I respect the King's opinion."

622.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
622.text: "All well and good. I respect your choice."

623.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
623.text: "So it is. I will respect your choice."

629.speaker: Player_Romus
629.text: "Thank you, Laurento, for your wise counsel."

630.speaker: Player_Romus
630.text: "Thank you for the idea, Vina. Queen Lyza would be proud."

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "Thank you for your wise counsel, Laurento."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "Is that all for today? I'm starting to lose my focus."

633.speaker: Player_Romus
633.text: "Good work today, everyone. I think it's time we adjourned."

637.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
637.text: "For now, I propose we move on with our briefing."

638.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
638.text: "Currently, their foreign ministry is working in close cooperation with us and President Smolak has promised to honor the treaty."

640.speaker: Lucita Azaro
640.text: "It's also a failsafe in case reconciliation doesn't work out. The more Palesians like us, the less inclined they'll be to attack us."

646.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
646.text: "Your father confided in me about your meeting with Duke Reinhart. But he never told me what came of it."

650.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
650.text: "Perhaps we should come to him first."

651.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
651.text: "Perhaps he was hoping for a change of attitude."

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "He wanted renewed relations between Rizia and Pales. As do I."

653.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
653.text: "It's refreshing to hear you say that."

654.speaker: Player_Romus
654.text: "We met, he showed me around. It wasn't a big deal."

655.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
655.text: "Given the history of conflict between our nations, that's a very big deal."

656.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
656.text: "Back in the 1920s, there were a few attempts at marshalling support for a Valgslandian Socialist revolution in the Grand Duchy. None bore fruit."

660.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
660.text: "You were under pressure. As a fellow royal, he'll understand."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "I remember that meeting all too well. Now that I'm king, Reinhart will pay the price for his arrogance."

666.speaker: Narrator
666.text: To the west was a labyrinthine hedge maze, made of laurels donated from the Kingdom of Nahrburk.

667.speaker: Hugo Toras
667.text: "The royal decree on Sovereign Transition and Royal Clemency still awaits your signature."

671.speaker: Hugo Toras
671.text: "Your Majesty, may I have a brief word?"

672.speaker: Hugo Toras
672.text: "The delay is causing administrative challenges, and the public has started to remark on it."

673.speaker: Hugo Toras
673.text: "Allowing the decree to go unsigned is a serious breach of tradition. One that risks eroding the foundations of the Rizian monarchy, and calling your very authority as king into question."

675.speaker: Player_Romus
675.text: "I have decided not to sign the decree. Now is the time for Rizia to make a break from the archaic practices of the past." [-2 Authority]

676.speaker: Player_Romus
676.text: "Thank you for bringing this to my attention. I will see what I can do."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "The decree slipped my mind amidst the myriad duties of the crown. I swear that I will see to its signing immediately."

678.speaker: Hugo Toras
678.text: "I thank you in turn for taking my advice seriously. The importance of tradition in our kingdom cannot be overstated."

679.speaker: Hugo Toras
679.text: "In that case... I stand ready to advise you on the consequences."

680.speaker: Hugo Toras
680.text: "That would be much appreciated, Your Majesty."

688.speaker: Player_Romus
688.text: "The Queen remains amicable towards me. She recognizes how I managed to live alongside Lena."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: The Queen still holds me in her affections. She is aware of the love I harbored for Lena, a love that transcends even her passing."

693.speaker: Player_Romus
693.text: "The Queen is still fond of me as well. She knows how much I loved Lena." [Lie]

699.speaker: Player_Romus
699.text: "Thank you for the advice. But I'd rather not fund any expansion of this organization for now."

701.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
701.text: "Which is why the Golcondist bans that have been implemented over the last few decades -- including ours -- have been met with occasionally violent resistance from the Derdians."

706.speaker: Elena Werner
706.text: "Sorry to rain on everyone's parade. Perhaps we can revisit the idea in the future."

710.speaker: Player_Romus
710.text: "I hope so. Thank you for your suggestion, Laurento."

711.speaker: Player_Romus
711.text: "I look forward to the day when we can afford to put my daughter's brilliant proposal into action."

713.speaker: Vina Toras
713.text: "You flatter me, Father. It was mostly Laurento's idea."

717.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
717.text: "You are too kind, Your Majesty. It was your daughter who first thought of it."

719.speaker: Player_Romus
719.text: "One minute longer and you would've had to call in the Palace medical staff to bring me out of a coma."

722.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
722.text: "Point taken. I'll make an effort to be more entertaining next time."

723.speaker: Hugo Toras
723.text: "I will also add that you yourself promised me that you would sign it."

727.speaker: Player_Romus
727.text: "That was before I read the fine print. Did you truly think I would agree to release 500 prisoners? Just how soft-bellied do you think I am?" [-1 Authority]

728.speaker: Player_Romus
728.text: "I changed my mind. Now is the time for Rizia to make a break from the archaic practices of the past." [-2 Authority]

730.speaker: Hugo Toras
730.text: "I... understand completely. I stand ready to advise you should consequences arise."

731.speaker: Player_Romus
731.text: "Traditional or not, I refuse to begin my reign with the release of 500 prisoners. Just how soft-bellied do you think I am?"  [-1 Authority]

734.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
734.text: "I should mention that the Derdians' isolation is partially self-imposed. They are suspicious of nations that do not share their particular values."

735.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
735.text: "Among other things, these include a hard-line stance on drugs and alcohol."

736.speaker: Player_Romus
736.text: "But I love -- I mean, Rizia loves -- drugs and alcohol!"

740.speaker: Player_Romus
740.text: "Are Rizia's current drug laws strict enough for their liking?"

744.speaker: Player_Romus
744.text: "Rizia is in alignment with them, then. Those substances are the work of the devil."

745.speaker: Player_Romus
745.text: "But Wruhecism permits alcohol. It's even used in our rituals, right, Grand Wiseman?"

749.speaker: Player_Romus
749.text: "That's interesting to know. But I won't be adapting Rizia's policies to suit Derdia's wishes."

750.speaker: Hugo Toras
750.text: "Even as an occasional wine drinker, I object to changing any of our country's laws to please Golcondists."

751.speaker: Hugo Toras
751.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. We should not let Golcondists tell us how to run our country."

752.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
752.text: "Well... no. After we legalized illegal substances, the Derdian papers started referring to Rizia as 'the land of sin'."

756.speaker: Narrator
756.text: Lucita tried in vain to hold back a laugh.

757.speaker: Lucita Azaro
757.text: "We should put that in the tourism brochures."

758.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
758.text: "Yes, barely. If we wish to pursue diplomatic ties with Derdia, we should refrain from relaxing them."

759.speaker: Hugo Toras
759.text: "I agree that allowing more drugs into the country is a bad idea. But we shouldn't let Golcondist whims dictate our internal policy."

761.speaker: Sal Ignacius
761.text: "However, not all Wruhecists agree that such substances should be used for one's secular enjoyment."

762.speaker: Hugo Toras
762.text: "Hrm. I'm sure even St. Wruhec permitted himself the occasional glass of wine outside of prayer hours."

763.speaker: Narrator
763.text: Hugo tried to cover up his offended look.

764.speaker: Sal Ignacius
764.text: "The secular use of these substances is a point of contention even among certain mainstream Wruhecists, yes."

765.speaker: Hugo Toras
765.text: "Wine is practically its own religion in Rizia, Grand Wiseman. We should not change our stance just to please Golcondists."

768.speaker: Player_Romus
768.text: "No need, Laurento. I've done all the necessary research already."

769.speaker: Player_Romus
769.text: "Yes, please go on, Mr. Esquibel. I've been searching for a new sleep aid since the pharmacy stopped carrying opium."

772.speaker: Narrator
772.text: Laurento paused with a frown, then walked over to the back wall and unrolled a map of southeastern Merkopa.

774.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
774.text: "Oh! I suppose I shouldn't be surprised."

780.speaker: Player_Romus
780.text: "Do we have military options to use against Wehlen?"

782.speaker: Lucita Azaro
782.text: "Outside of Zille, very few that are realistic, Your Majesty."

783.speaker: Lucita Azaro
783.text: "President Smolak has spent years fortifying his coastline. The sea approaches are heavily mined, and reinforced with layered naval batteries. United Contana's aid allowed Wehlen to significantly expand those defenses. A naval invasion across the gulf would be operationally unimaginable."

784.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
784.text: "For all his rhetoric, Smolak seeks security and legitimacy. An outright attack would push him firmly into United Contana’s embrace, perhaps beyond retrieval."

785.speaker: Hugo Toras
785.text: "If we move against Wehlen openly, we risk strengthening the very man we could wish to keep in check."

786.speaker: Lucita Azaro
786.text: "Additionally, our navy lacks the necessary amphibious capacity for a sustained landing. We also do not possess enough advanced vessels capable of reliably detecting and clearing minefields in the Gulf."

787.speaker: Lucita Azaro
787.text: "Zille is a different matter. It lies on our mainland. There, we can exert intelligence and limited military pressure with far greater feasibility."

788.speaker: Player_Romus
788.text: "Then Zille is our only pressure point?"

789.speaker: Player_Romus
789.text: "Could we overwhelm their defenses with a rapid strike?"

790.speaker: Player_Romus
790.text: "What about air superiority? Could we neutralize their batteries from above?"

791.speaker: Lucita Azaro
791.text: "The minefields and overlapping coastal guns would break any rapid assault before it reaches land."

792.speaker: Lucita Azaro
792.text: "Contanan radar and anti-air systems would blunt our strikes long before their batteries are neutralized."

793.speaker: Lucita Azaro
793.text: "It is the only front where we can apply controlled military and intelligence pressure from our mainland."

794.speaker: Player_Romus
794.text: "I have no desire for war. Wehlen stood by us in a dire time. I will not forget that."

795.speaker: Lucita Azaro
795.text: "We can maintain readiness without provoking the hand that once aided us."
